name: helen-original-60-frozen-model-holdout-window
label_source: Original iBUG 300W semi-automatic PTS annotations, retained by the public dlib repack; no newly performed human testing; native training overlap unknown
image_terms: iBUG annotations are research-only; not for commercial products or commercial algorithm training. Original photograph rights remain with their owners. https://ibug.doc.ic.ac.uk/resources/facial-point-annotations/ https://ibug.doc.ic.ac.uk/resources/300-W/
grouping_limit: At most one original face per numeric HELEN photograph filename root. Mirrors excluded and exact aliases rejected. Filename roots do not establish person independence, unknown related photographs or model training overlap; no population coverage claim. The unchanged seed and rank window follow the prior 60-source donor cohort; no resampling or outcome-dependent replacement. This study was chosen after prior studies and does not correct adaptive cross-study selection.

protocol.domain: Prospectively frozen HELEN testset source-root window [60,120); unchanged donor model and published PTS agreement; visibility, person independence and native training overlap unknown
